Synopsis:
A new analysis by F Minus and Make Polluters Pay exposes a systemic conflict of interest in US congressional lobbying: the same firms representing fossil fuel majors (ExxonMobil, API, ConocoPhillips) are simultaneously lobbying on behalf of 300+ local governments seeking climate damage funding. Greenberg Traurig is cited as the starkest example. The piece also covers the fossil fuel industry's coordinated opposition to state-level climate superfund legislation and the federal Stop Climate Shakedowns Act, which aims to nullify such laws and related lawsuits.
